name: Astral Projection reduces the energy cost of Celestial Strike and Moon Arrow by 10 (#1788)
contract: Astral Projection 300994 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 32, passive) carries one effect: SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue 14 = SPELLMOD_COST, EffectBasePoints -11 with DieSides 1 resolving to -10, and EffectSpellClassMask word1 0x6. Celestial Strike (800496, 502286-502294; SpellFamilyFlags word1 0x2, PowerType 3 energy, ManaCost 40) and Moon Arrow (801972, 803918-803925; word1 0x4, PowerType 3, ManaCost 40) carry those bits. The tooltip reads 'Reduces the Energy cost of Celestial Strike and Moon Arrow by $s1.' (s1 = 10). Native path only: SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost applies Player::ApplySpellMod(SPELLMOD_COST) to the power cost after the base cost, and a flat modifier is added as is (Player::ApplySpellMod, basevalue * totalmul + totalflat). None of these spells has ManaCostPercentage, and AscensionStarcallerContracts.cpp rewrites costs only for the ids in StarcallerCosts (Aegis and other mana spells), none of which is a Celestial Strike or Moon Arrow rank. The spell_power_cost metric calls SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost for the fixture. Both fixtures are the same race, class and level with no gear, so the difference of the two readings can only come from the passive. Rank 1 and the top rank of each spell are checked because the mask covers every rank.
